import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('taskprog',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
# Reconstruct demos from their regular separators and listed corner marks.
def make_grid(h,w,bg,hr,vc,line,marks):
    g=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in hr:
        for c in range(w): g[r][c]=line
    for c in vc:
        for r in range(h): g[r][c]=line
    for (r,c),v in marks.items(): g[r][c]=v
    return g
m1={}
for r in (0,5):
    for c in (0,4):m1[r,c]=5
    for c in (20,24):m1[r,c]=1
for r in (10,):
    for c in (0,4):m1[r,c]=1
    for c in (8,12):m1[r,c]=0
for r in (15,):
    for c in (0,4):m1[r,c]=1
    for c in (8,12,16):m1[r,c]=0
    for c in (20,24):m1[r,c]=9
for r in (20,):
    for c in (12,16):m1[r,c]=0
    for c in (20,24):m1[r,c]=9
d1=make_grid(22,29,8,[0,5,10,15,20],list(range(0,29,4)),4,m1)
